trap.label: resultado × processo
trap.wrong: They have argued for years and have been solving the problem.
trap.right: They have been arguing for years and have solved the problem.
trap.why: Em português “têm discutido” e “têm resolvido” usam a mesma estrutura. Em inglês, duração/processo = have been + -ing; resultado concluído = have + particípio.

mcq.q: The cake is ready. I ___ it.
My hands are dirty. I ___ the car.

opts: I have been writing since noon.

fix.wrong: I have been finishing three reports.
She has been sleep all day.
fix.right: She has been sleeping all day.
They have been arguing for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva focando duração: “They have argued for years.”
rewrite.answer: They have been arguing for years.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva focando resultado: “She has been painting the wall.” (terminou)
Pergunte quantidade: “She has read books.” (How many)
rewrite.answer: How many books has she read?
